label: A favouring determination that misses a verdict of value is not pure
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred: for every favouring profile phi, if phi misses a verdict of the betterness standard read as value (STANDARD_OF_FAVOURING_1: for some scenario and candidates x, y, x is a better good than y there and phi does not favour x over y there), then the real determination that a favouring of the bearer is phi is not a pure perfection (DEF-PURE-PERFECTION; the same purity parameter as the #2153 premises). It is the loss half of 'restriction of favouring content is limitation' in its value-relative form. The Lean function takes the standard as a parameter; applied with the end-realization ordering (STANDARD_OF_FAVOURING_2) it gives the D-relative form, which is not this statement and under which the good-tracking profile, not the D-directed one, is restricted. It concerns only the verdicts of favouring profiles.
